title: The 7 reasons you can't be a psychologist

sentences.en: What if your professional expertise could earn you money even when you're not working?
sentences.zh: 如果你除了日常工作之外，还能通过专业知识赚取外快，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and since 2019 I've been building additional income streams
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士（Dr. Marianne Trent），自2019年以来，我一直在拓展额外的收入来源

sentences.en: through books, online courses, and memberships, and it's made such a difference to my business and my life.
sentences.zh: 通过书籍、在线课程和会员项目，这给我的业务和生活带来了巨大的改变。

sentences.en: Tonight at 7pm, Sophie Foote is hosting a free Make Money Online Masterclass, exploring how you can turn your existing skills and knowledge into additional income streaMs.
sentences.zh: 今天晚上7点，苏菲·富特（Sophie Foote）将主持一场免费的“在线赚钱大师班”，探讨如何将你现有的技能和知识转化为额外的收入来源。

sentences.en: And I'd love more psychologists and mental health professionals to join us.
sentences.zh: 我非常希望有更多的心理学家和心理健康专业人士加入我们。

sentences.en: I'll be there too, supporting a lovely community of fellow psychologists, exploring what's possible beyond one-to-one work.
sentences.zh: 我也会出席，支持一个由同行心理学家组成的可爱的社群，探索一对一工作之外的无限可能。

sentences.en: Replays are available if you can't join live.
sentences.zh: 如果你无法参加直播，我们提供回放。

sentences.en: Click the link with this pre-roll or reach out to me on socials to grab your free place, because you can serve others and deserve financial freedom too.
sentences.zh: 点击此片头广告中的链接，或者在社交媒体上联系我来获取你的免费名额，因为你不仅可以服务他人，你也理应获得财务自由。

sentences.en: Ever been told you shouldn't be a psychologist?
sentences.zh: 有没有人对你说过，你不应该成为一名心理学家？

sentences.en: In this eye-opening episode, we are debunking the seven most common misconceptions
sentences.zh: 在这期大开眼界的节目中，我们将揭穿七大最常见的误解

sentences.en: that might be holding you back or making you question your compatibility with a career in psychology.
sentences.zh: 这些误解可能会阻碍你的脚步，或者让你怀疑自己是否适合从事心理学职业。

sentences.en: Get ready to challenge those doubts and discover the truth about what it really takes to thrive in this incredibly rewarding profession.
sentences.zh: 准备好迎接这些质疑，去发现真相吧——了解在这个极其有意义的职业中真正取得成功需要什么。

sentences.en: Let's break down the barriers and redefine your perspective on becoming a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 让我们打破这些壁垒，重新定义你对成为心理学家的看法。

sentences.en: Stay tuned, hope you find it useful.
sentences.zh: 请继续收听，希望你觉得这期节目有用。

sentences.en: Welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist PodcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到《有志心理学家播客》（Aspiring Psychologist Podcast）。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: But would I be if I had received other messages about myself as part of my journey when I was an aspiring psychologist?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果我在立志成为心理学家的成长历程中，曾收到过关于我自己的其他讯息，我还会是现在的我吗？

sentences.en: Would I be if I had already believed certain things about myself, my capabilities, my opportunities as I was growing up?
sentences.zh: 如果我在成长过程中，就已经对自己、对我的能力、对我的机遇深信某些事情，我还会是现在的我吗？

sentences.en: Let's take a little bit of a look into seven reasons people might think they're incompatible with this fantastic career of psychology.
sentences.zh: 让我们来探讨人们认为自己不适合心理学这个绝佳职业的七个原因。

sentences.en: Reason number one, you won't cope, not with your mental health or not with what you've been through
sentences.zh: 原因之一，你会撑不住，无论是从心理健康方面，还是从你经历过的那些事情来看

sentences.en: or actually what I've recognised and seen in you lately since you've responded to this, that or the other crisis in your personal life.
sentences.zh: 或者其实是我最近在你应对个人生活中的这样或那样的危机时，在你身上认识到并看到的情况。

sentences.en: I just think this is horrendous, you know?
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得这太可怕了，你知道吗？

sentences.en: How is this being told to people by people who are supposed to be qualified, who are supposed
sentences.zh: 怎么能对人们说这种话呢？说这些话的本应是那些合格的、应该

sentences.en: to believe in capacity for change and growth, you know, potentially to be the people that are supposed to be helping support employees through episodes of crisis?
sentences.zh: 相信人们有能力改变和成长的人，潜在地，他们本应是在危机期间帮助支持员工的人？

sentences.en: This cropped up recently for me as part of a Facebook group that I'm in and somebody's supervisor had actually told them this.
sentences.zh: 这事最近在我加入的一个Facebook群组里出现了，某个人的导师竟然对他们这么说过。

sentences.en: And I was horrified because for me as a supervisor, I think my job is, well, how can I help support you through this difficult time?
sentences.zh: 我感到非常震惊，因为对我而言，作为一名导师，我认为我的工作是：我该如何在此艰难时期协助支持你？

sentences.en: How can I be my optimal best to give you what you need to,
sentences.zh: 我如何才能发挥出最佳状态，给予你所需要的东西，以让你

sentences.en: you know, if not thrive through this period, survive through this period so that you can go on to have growth and to come
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果不是在这个时期蓬勃发展，也是在这个时期生存下来，这样你就能继续成长并

sentences.en: out the other side.
sentences.zh: 走出阴霾。

sentences.en: And really one of the main reasons I would say that I started this podcast was to provide
sentences.zh: 真的，我创办这个播客的主要原因之一，就是为

sentences.en: listeners and the watchers on YouTube, subscribe and like if you are watching on YouTube with an alternative narrative.
sentences.zh: 听众以及YouTube上的观众（如果你在YouTube上观看，请订阅并点赞）提供一个替代的视角。

sentences.en: If you are in a team or supervised or know of psychologists who don't seem to want to fuel
sentences.zh: 如果你所在的团队、你的导师，或者你认识的某些心理学家似乎并不想激励

sentences.en: you to help you to, you know, sprinkle compassion around liberally to make you believe that you can do this or to inspire you to want to do this.
sentences.zh: 你，不想帮助你（你知道的），不想慷慨地播撒同理心让你相信你能做到这一点，或者不想激发你想要这样做的动力。

sentences.en: You know, you're not seeing that good practice that's making you go, yes, this is the reason
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你没有看到那种让你觉得“是的，这就是我

sentences.en: I'm doing this.
sentences.zh: 在做这件事的原因”的优秀实践。

sentences.en: Now, this is one of the reasons I put the podcast together to give you hope, to give you an alternative perspective.
sentences.zh: 现在，这也是我制作这个播客的原因之一，为了给你希望，给你提供一个替代的视角。

sentences.en: So, you know, the idea that this is being told to people is really horrifying for me.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，这种话居然会被对别人说起，这让我感到非常震惊。

sentences.en: And it made me think about the time that I was doing a master's distance learning whilst working full time.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了我一边全职工作，一边攻读硕士远程学习的那段时光。

sentences.en: I had had a car accident.
sentences.zh: 我遭遇了一场车祸。

sentences.en: I had back probleMs.
sentences.zh: 我有背部问题。

sentences.en: I was seeing an osteopath and physiotherapist for due to the car accident.
sentences.zh: 因为车祸，我当时正在看整骨医生和物理治疗师。

sentences.en: I'd broken up with a partner, a long-term partner at that time.
sentences.zh: 那时我和一个伴侣、一个长期伴侣分手了。

sentences.en: Things were really tricky for me at that time.
sentences.zh: 那段时间我的情况真的很棘手。

sentences.en: But at no point did anybody say, this isn't for you.
sentences.zh: 但从来没有人说过，这不适合你。

sentences.en: You know, I guess because I held it together, I was doing still what I needed to do.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我想是因为我撑过来了，我仍在做我需要做的事情。

sentences.en: But it was a hard time in my life.
sentences.zh: 但那是我生命中艰难的一段时期。

sentences.en: But that was the cycle of applications that I got on to clinical training.
sentences.zh: 也就是在那一轮申请中，我进入了临床培训。

sentences.en: And I do believe it made me a better clinician for navigating those experiences.
sentences.zh: 我确实相信，驾驭这些经历让我成为了一名更好的临床医生。

sentences.en: And it also made me reflect upon one of my dear friends and colleagues, Dr. Cara Davey, who lost a child, who gave birth to a stillborn daughter.
sentences.zh: 这也让我回想起我的一位挚友和同事——卡拉·戴维博士（Dr. Cara Davey），她失去了一个孩子，生下一个死产的女儿。

sentences.en: And it had been incredibly difficult, incredibly painful.
sentences.zh: 那段经历极其艰难，极其痛苦。

sentences.en: And of course, continues to be as well.
sentences.zh: 而且当然，这种痛苦至今仍在继续。

sentences.en: You know, it shapes us and our experience and what we think of the world and how we perceive risk and, you know, our hope and all of that.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，它塑造了我们、我们的经验、我们对世界的看法、我们对风险的感知，以及（你知道的）我们的希望等等。

sentences.en: But, you know, had that happened to her at an earlier stage of her career, she might have felt that she wasn't, you know, cut out for psychology or she wouldn't cope with it.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，如果那件事在她职业生涯的早期发生在她身上，她可能会觉得自己不适合

sentences.en: Or maybe somebody might even have told her that.
sentences.zh: 心理学，或者觉得自己无法应对它。

sentences.en: Because, of course, some certain key events will feel like they decimate us personally and professionally.
sentences.zh: 或者甚至可能有人会对她说这样的话。

sentences.en: Because they're big, because they, you know, you will see this either in your own lives, those you care about, or in colleagues, friends.
sentences.zh: 因为，当然，某些关键事件在个人和职业层面上会让我们感觉遭受了毁灭性的打击。

sentences.en: Sometimes big, massive things happen to humans.
sentences.zh: 因为它们很大，因为你（你知道的）会在你自己的生活中、在你关心的人身上，或者在同事、朋友身上看到这一点。

sentences.en: And we have to be able to navigate through that.
sentences.zh: 有时候，巨大的事情会降临到人类身上。

sentences.en: And, you know, you learn a lot through adversity, is what I would say.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，我们必须能够度过难关。

sentences.en: And it might well mean that you end up making that your clinical specialism, as Cara has done.
sentences.zh: 这很可能意味着你最终会像卡拉那样，将这作为你的临床专长。

sentences.en: So, Cara does lots of work for people that have had loss pregnancies, loss of children, and late miscarriages or stillbirths.
sentences.zh: 所以，卡拉为经历过流产、失去孩子、晚期流产或死产的人做了大量的工作。

sentences.en: And it's incredibly useful.
sentences.zh: 这极其有用。

sentences.en: And I know the people that work with her find it really useful that she's had similar experience.
sentences.zh: 我知道与她共事的人都觉得很有用，因为她有过类似经历。

sentences.en: Whilst you don't need to get hit by a bus to know that it hurts, it sure does help for your empathy.
sentences.zh: 虽然你不需要被公交车撞过才知道它很痛，但这确实对你的同理心很有帮助。

sentences.en: But, yeah, in terms of mental health, I think if your mental health is well managed, and you are accessing the appropriate treatment and mental health support if needed,
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，就心理健康而言，我认为如果你的心理健康管理得当，并且在需要时获得了适当的治疗和心理健康支持，

sentences.en: there's no reason you can't be a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 没有任何理由你不能成为一名心理学家。

sentences.en: It might be that you, you know, use supervision and, you know, ongoing therapy, and you stay mindful.
sentences.zh: 可能你需要（你知道的）利用督导，（你知道的）持续的治疗，并且保持正念。

sentences.en: And you know, hopefully, by this stage in your life, what keeps you well, what helps you thrive.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道的，希望到了人生的这个阶段，你已经知道是什么能让你保持健康，是什么能助你蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: And so it's going to be, like any of us, it's going to be your responsibility to make sure that as much as possible, you're getting that balance that means that it's possible.
sentences.zh: 所以，和我们所有人一样，你将有责任确保在最大程度上获得这种平衡，从而使之成为可能。

sentences.en: And it also made me think about a story that someone had told me about when they were an assistant psychologist and experienced two massive traumas in the same year,
sentences.zh: 这也让我想起了一个故事，有人曾跟我讲述过他们作为助理心理学家时，在同一年经历了两次巨大的创伤，

sentences.en: the loss of a fiancé and a loss of a father.
sentences.zh: 失去了未婚夫和父亲。

sentences.en: That's a lot to go through.
sentences.zh: 要经历这些实在太不容易了。

sentences.en: And that person was told by a supervisor, I don't think you're going to be psychologically strong enough to be a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 而那个人曾被一位导师告知：“我认为你在心理上不够坚强，无法成为一名心理学家。”

sentences.en: I think you ought to think about doing something different, which is just incredibly galling.
sentences.zh: “我想你应该考虑做点别的。”这话实在是太气人了。

sentences.en: How can you expect anybody to go through that sort of year and not be impacted upon it?
sentences.zh: 你怎么能指望任何人经历那样的一年却不受其影响呢？

sentences.en: But I know that that person is now a qualified psychologist and does a really, really good job.
sentences.zh: 但我知道那个人现在是一名合格的心理学家，而且工作做得非常非常出色。

sentences.en: And so, you know, whatever stage of your career you are as you're listening to this, just be kind, just be mindful, be supportive.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，无论你在听这段音频时处于职业生涯的哪个阶段，请保持善良，请保持正念，给予支持。

sentences.en: You know, let's not be a hater.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们不要当键盘侠（hater）。

sentences.en: Let's know what we know about mental health, about, you know, difficult times, about being supportive.
sentences.zh: 让我们运用我们所了解的关于心理健康、关于（你知道的）艰难时期、关于给予支持的知识。

sentences.en: And let's think, you know, of course, you might have clinical concerns about somebody's ability to do a job.
sentences.zh: 让我们这样想：当然，你可能会对某人胜任工作的能力产生临床担忧。

sentences.en: That is a different issue.
sentences.zh: 那是另一个问题。

sentences.en: You know, if you don't feel like they are doing things enough to be able to safeguard risk and, you know, that is a separate issue.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果你觉得他们做的事情不够多，无法保障风险（你知道的），那是另一个问题。

sentences.en: But, you know, the reason to exclude somebody from the career of psychology is not just because they've had a mental health history.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，将某人排斥在心理学职业之外的理由，绝不仅仅是因为他们有过心理健康病史。

sentences.en: It isn't because they've experienced trauma in their own lives.
sentences.zh: 也不是因为他们在自己的生活中经历过创伤。

sentences.en: You know, this is a case by case basis.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这是具体情况具体分析的。

sentences.en: And maybe someone needs a period of sick leave.
sentences.zh: 也许有人需要一段时间的病假。

sentences.en: And that's OK.
sentences.zh: 这没关系。

sentences.en: That doesn't make them a failure.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着他们是失败者。

sentences.en: Doesn't make them not cut out for the career of psychology, whichever discipline they go into.
sentences.zh: 并不意味着他们不适合心理学职业，无论他们选择哪个细分领域。

sentences.en: You know, let's think about supporting our colleagues.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，让我们考虑支持我们的同事。

sentences.en: So that was reason one.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是第一个原因。

sentences.en: Reason two is that somebody is either diagnosed or, you know, identifies with or even just has traits of doesn't want to go through diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 第二个原因，有人被诊断出、或者（你知道的）认同有、甚至只是有某种特质但不想去经历诊断。

sentences.en: Issues of neurodiversity that might be autism spectrum, condition, disorder, whatever you call it or refer to it as.
sentences.zh: 神经多样性的问题，可能是自闭症谱系、状况、障碍，无论你怎么称呼它或指代它。

sentences.en: It might be ADHD, it might be dyslexia, it might be dyspraxia, it might be a whole range of things.
sentences.zh: 可能是多动症（ADHD），可能是阅读障碍（dyslexia），可能是动作协调障碍（dyspraxia），可能是各种各样的问题。

sentences.en: And for that, I would say, you know, let's not be too ableist here.
sentences.zh: 对于这一点，我想说的是，（你知道的）我们在这里不要表现得过于健全主义（ableist）。

sentences.en: You know, our clients that we work with are going to be very diverse.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们合作的客户将是非常多元化的。

sentences.en: And, you know, why shouldn't our mental health services be made up of people that are equally diverse and colourful?
sentences.zh: 而且，（你知道的）为什么我们的心理健康服务不能由同样多元化、丰富多彩的人组成呢？

sentences.en: That's what I believe.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的信念。

sentences.en: You know, variety is the spice of life.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，变化是生活调味品。

sentences.en: And how can we learn more about shaping our services and making sure they really are fit for purpose if we are not talking the talk and walking the walk and listening to the voices of people who know what it is going to be that makes a difference?
sentences.zh: 如果我们不言行一致、不付诸行动、不倾听那些知道是什么带来改变的人的心声，我们又怎么能更多地了解如何塑造我们的服务并确保它们真正符合目标呢？

sentences.en: And this might be a really nice opportunity to tell you about a very exciting book project that is coming with two of my colleagues, one of whom you've met already, Nikita,
sentences.zh: 这可能是一个非常好的机会，向你讲述一个非常令人兴奋的书籍项目，它由我和我的两位同事共同完成，其中一位你已经见过了，尼基塔（Nikita），

sentences.en: who is currently a first year clinical psychology trainee, and Dr. Vicky Jarvis, who is a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 她目前是一名第一年临床心理学实习生，还有维姬·贾维斯博士（Dr. Vicky Jarvis），她是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: And very excitingly, this book now has a title.
sentences.zh: 非常令人兴奋的是，这本书现在已经有了书名。

sentences.en: It is Becoming a Thing and it's Beautiful.
sentences.zh: 它正在酝酿成型，而且很美妙。

sentences.en: It is called An Autistic Anthology, Neuro Narratives of Mental Health Professionals.
sentences.zh: 它叫做《自闭症文集：心理健康专业人士的神经叙事》（An Autistic Anthology, Neuro Narratives of Mental Health Professionals）。

sentences.en: And if you're listening to this and you think, yes, I would love to get involved, there is still time.
sentences.zh: 如果你听到这里，并且觉得“是的，我很想参与”，现在还来得及。

sentences.en: So this book is for people that either identify as having autism or have a diagnosis of autism.
sentences.zh: 所以这本书是为那些自认为是自闭症患者或已被诊断为自闭症的人准备的。

sentences.en: That is what we are looking at.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们正在寻找的对象。

sentences.en: So if that describes you and you'd love to tell your story in a collective anthology, please do get in contact with me and we can we can do our best to get you in the book,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果这符合你的情况，并且你很乐意在合集文中讲述你的故事，请务必联系我，我们可以尽最大努力把你写进书里，

sentences.en: which we should hopefully be on track for publishing in the summer.
sentences.zh: 我们希望这本书能在夏天按计划出版。

sentences.en: We need to break that stigma, you know, that people with issues of neurodiversity cannot be working in mental health.
sentences.zh: 我们需要打破这种耻辱感，你知道的，即有神经多样性问题的人不能在心理健康领域工作。

sentences.en: So you don't have to be a psychologist to contribute to that book.
sentences.zh: 所以你不需要成为一名心理学家就能为那本书做出贡献。

sentences.en: But if you work in mental health, we would love to be able to feature you in that if you've got a story you would like to tell.
sentences.zh: 但如果你在心理健康领域工作，如果你有一个想讲述的故事，我们非常希望能将你的经历收录其中。

sentences.en: So, yeah, you know, somebody with ADHD, for somebody with dyslexia, for example, you might need some additional support.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，你知道的，对于多动症患者，比如对于阅读障碍患者，你可能需要一些额外的支持。

sentences.en: You might need some planning, some more proofreading.
sentences.zh: 你可能需要一些规划，更多的校对。

sentences.en: But these are options that are available within universities.
sentences.zh: 但这些都是大学里可以提供的选择。

sentences.en: And when you are employed, there are options for access to work and inclusion and all of that.
sentences.zh: 当你受雇时，也有诸如工作无障碍通道（Access to Work）和包容性等选项。

sentences.en: So, you know, if you can have the dream, you can shoot your shot just because those issues might be around for you doesn't mean you can't or you shouldn't be a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，如果你有梦想，就可以大胆去尝试（shoot your shot），仅仅因为这些问题可能会伴随着你，并不意味着你不能或不应该成为一名心理学家。

sentences.en: Reason number three, perhaps you're already a parent or you like to become a parent in the next couple of years.
sentences.zh: 第三个原因，也许你已经为人父母，或者你希望在未来几年内成为父母。

sentences.en: And for that, I would say, don't forget, we did interview Rose Dunstan, who at the time was a trainee clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 对于这一点，我想说，别忘了，我们曾采访过罗斯·邓斯坦（Rose Dunstan），当时她是一名临床心理学实习生

sentences.en: And also a parent.
sentences.zh: 同时也是一位母亲。

sentences.en: Do check that episode out if you think you might find that useful.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得这会对你有所帮助，请务必去听听那一期节目。

sentences.en: That was episode 25.
sentences.zh: 那是第25期节目。

sentences.en: You know, I am a parent and I had my children after I finished training.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我是一个父母，我的孩子是我完成培训之后才生的。

sentences.en: Primarily probably because I hadn't met a partner that I wanted to have children with earlier.
sentences.zh: 主要原因可能是因为我之前没有遇到一个我想早点和他生孩子的伴侣。

sentences.en: Otherwise, my own journey may have looked different.
sentences.zh: 否则，我自己的经历可能会是另一番景象。

sentences.en: And all I can speak from really is my experience of parenting now, which is post-qualification.
sentences.zh: 我真正能谈论的，其实只是我现在作为父母的经验，那是在获得资格认证之后的事。

sentences.en: And children do shift your priorities.
sentences.zh: 孩子确实会转移你的重心。

sentences.en: They do make things a little more complicated.
sentences.zh: 它们确实会让事情变得稍微复杂一些。

sentences.en: They do mean that you need to plan more in advance.
sentences.zh: 它们确实意味着你需要提前做更多计划。

sentences.en: But, you know, the other day I wrote six chapters of a book in two hours because that is the time I had available.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，前几天我在两个小时内写了一本书的六个章节，因为那是当时我仅有的时间。

sentences.en: If that had been write an assignment and I had two hours, it would probably have got the bulk of what I needed to do done in two hours.
sentences.zh: 如果那是一份作业而我只有两个小时，我可能也会在两个小时内完成我需要做的大部分工作。

sentences.en: Whereas when I was training, if I'd had an assignment and I had a whole week to write it, it would have taken me a whole week.
sentences.zh: 然而，当我在接受培训时，如果我有一份作业，并且有一整周的时间来写，我会花掉整整一周。

sentences.en: You know, I think what parenting does is it helps you identify the gaps where you've got to be able to get things done and it empowers you to get them done.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我认为为人父母所做的是，它帮你找出必须完成事情的空隙，并赋予你完成它们的底气。

sentences.en: Now, of course, that's if your child is well enough.
sentences.zh: 当然，前提是你的孩子身体健康。

sentences.en: It's if you've got child care.
sentences.zh: 前提是你有人帮忙带孩子。

sentences.en: But, you know, a training course and counselling training doctorates, you are having to do placement hours, you're having to do university time,
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，在培训课程和咨询培训博士项目中，你必须完成实习小时数，你必须完成大学学业时间，

sentences.en: you are having to do often work on the side to be able to afford to live.
sentences.zh: 你通常还得兼职工作才能负担得起生活。

sentences.en: You know, you're having to do assignments and the same with obviously clinical psychology and forensic psychology.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你必须完成作业，临床心理学和法医心理学显然也是如此。

sentences.en: What I would say is if you're a parent already, you do need to have enough hours in your day to be able to do all of the things that you need to do.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，如果你已经是一个父母，你确实需要一天中有足够的时间来做你需要做完的所有事情。

sentences.en: So sometimes it's possible to to do your training over a longer period of time, but you would usually still be doing it full time.
sentences.zh: 所以有时候，你可以延长培训时间，但通常你仍然是全职进行的。

sentences.en: You know, so you can have maternity leave or paternity leave or parenting leave or adoption leave.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，所以你可以休产假、陪产假、父母假或收养假。

sentences.en: But at that point, you are expected ordinarily, as far as I'm aware, to come back and do it full time.
sentences.zh: 但在那之后，据我所知，通常情况下，你被期望回来继续全职完成它。

sentences.en: So you do need to have enough hours in the day to be able to do it and to be able to get it done and to pass what you need to do.
sentences.zh: 所以你确实需要一天中有足够的时间来完成它，把事情做好并通过你必须通过的考核。

sentences.en: But it is possible to be a parent or even to become a parent whilst you are training to be a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 但当你正在接受心理学家培训时，为人父母或甚至准备成为父母是完全可能的。

sentences.en: And speaking as a qualified psychologist, it most definitely is possible to be a parent when when you are working as a qualified psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 以合格心理学家的身份来说，当你作为一名合格的心理学家工作时，为人父母绝对是可能的。

sentences.en: So I have to confess the most I've ever worked as a parent is four days a week.
sentences.zh: 所以我必须承认，作为一个父母，我工作最多的时候也就是一周四天。

sentences.en: For me, it did feel essentially like I was doing five days of work in four.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，那感觉基本上就像是在四天里干完五天的工作。

sentences.en: But when I had my second child, I went down to three days a week and that definitely made me feel more part time.
sentences.zh: 但当我有了第二个孩子时，我减少到一周三天，这确实让我感觉更像是兼职了。

sentences.en: But of course, that does come with a drop in salary, which feels like a bit of a kicker.
sentences.zh: 但当然，这伴随着薪水的减少，感觉有点像个打击。

sentences.en: But I once worked with a forensic psychologist who didn't at that time have any children and still only worked four days and just had that one day a week for herself,
sentences.zh: 但我曾经和一位法医心理学家共事过，她当时没有孩子，而且仍然只工作四天，每周留出整整一天给自己，

sentences.en: which at the time I found it really hard to get my head around that she'd requested that and she didn't have anything else to do.
sentences.zh: 当时我觉得这很难理解，因为那是她自己要求的，而且她又没有别的事可做。

sentences.en: I was like, what do you do?
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，你到底在干嘛？

sentences.en: Like, what do you do with that day?
sentences.zh: 比如，那一整天你都用来做什么？

sentences.en: She goes, whatever I like.
sentences.zh: 她说，我想做什么就做什么。

sentences.en: And I couldn't get my head around why you wouldn't want more money and to work full time.
sentences.zh: 而我当时实在想不明白，为什么有人会不想要更多的钱，不想要全职工作。

sentences.en: I don't know why I didn't get it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么我当时就是不理解。

sentences.en: I get it now.
sentences.zh: 我现在明白了。

sentences.en: I get it now.
sentences.zh: 我现在明白了。

sentences.en: So, yes, that obviously has a financial implication if you do work less, but it can help you have a little bit more time for yourself.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，如果你减少工作，这显然会对财务产生一定影响，但它能帮你为自己多争取一点时间。

sentences.en: It can help you have a little bit more time for your children if obviously you do have children.
sentences.zh: 显然，如果你有孩子的话，它能帮你为孩子多争取一点时间。

sentences.en: And for me, it assuaged some of the guilt that other people were looking after my child or children more than I was.
sentences.zh: 对我而言，它缓解了一些内疚感——比起我，别人照顾我孩子的时间更多。

sentences.en: You know, I really loved my mummy days.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我真的很喜欢当妈妈的日子。

sentences.en: So I used to have Wednesday off, which was really nice because a really nice break in the week.
sentences.zh: 所以我以前周三休息，这真的很棒，因为这是周中的一个绝佳缓冲。

sentences.en: It meant I had Saturday and Sunday, went in for two days, had a day with me and my little boy.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我有周六和周日，然后工作两天，接着有一天属于我和我的小男孩。

sentences.en: And there was only us at the time and my husband, of course, but he was at work.
sentences.zh: 那时家里只有我们俩，当然还有我丈夫，但他要去上班。

sentences.en: And then I went in for a Thursday and a Friday and it was marvellous.
sentences.zh: 然后我周四和周五再去上班，感觉太棒了。

sentences.en: And then when I went three days a week, I had Wednesdays and Thursdays off.
sentences.zh: 后来当我每周只工作三天时，我周三和周四都休息。

sentences.en: And it just was so good.
sentences.zh: 感觉简直太棒了。

sentences.en: So good.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: I loved that.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢那样了。

sentences.en: I think back to that very fondly.
sentences.zh: 每当回想起来我都觉得非常温馨。

sentences.en: And it just meant that I was fully committed as a psychologist on the days I was there.
sentences.zh: 这意味着在我上班的日子里，我作为一名心理学家能够全身心投入。

sentences.en: And then, you know, I love being a parent and having the chance to do more of the school runs when they were a thing or go to baby and child groups,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我很享受当家长，有机会在孩子们需要时接送他们上下学，或者去参加婴儿和儿童俱乐部，

sentences.en: do all those things, you know, swimming lessons, you know, baby sensory, gymnastics,
sentences.zh: 做所有那些事情，你知道的，游泳课，婴儿感统课，体操，

sentences.en: like just being a mummy and watching my children grow, which was really, really important to me.
sentences.zh: 就像纯粹地当个妈妈，看着我的孩子们长大，这对我来说真的、真的很重要。

sentences.en: So you definitely can be a psychologist and a parent.
sentences.zh: 所以你完全可以既是一名心理学家，又是一位父母。

sentences.en: I am living proof.
sentences.zh: 我就是活生生的证明。

sentences.en: Let's take a little break here to listen to a jingle about one of my books.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里稍作休息，听一段关于我其中一本书的宣传广告。

sentences.en: And I hope you enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 希望你们会喜欢。

sentences.en: And I'll see you very soon.
sentences.zh: 我们很快就会再见面。

sentences.en: Welcome back.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来。

sentences.en: In the first half of the episode, we were thinking about three common reasons why people might have been told or might believe they are not cut out for psychology.
sentences.zh: 在节目的前半部分，我们探讨了人们被告知或认为自己不适合从事心理学行业的三个常见原因。

sentences.en: Let's plough on with reason number four is issues of physical health or maybe even that you are a wheelchair user.
sentences.zh: 我们继续来看第四个原因，即身体健康问题，甚至可能涉及到你是一名轮椅使用者。

sentences.en: Now, I think and hope we are very much moving to a more inclusive, less ableist perspective and viewpoint on this.
sentences.zh: 现在，我认为并希望我们在这一议题上正朝着一个更具包容性、较少能力歧视的视角和观点迈进。

sentences.en: And if you are a regular listener or watcher on YouTube, you might well recall that we very recently met Dr. Yvonne Waft, who is a wheelchair user.
sentences.zh: 如果你是YouTube上的常客或观众，你很可能还记得我们不久前采访过的身为轮椅使用者的Yvonne Waft博士。

sentences.en: We also met Gavin Clark in episode 111.
sentences.zh: 我们在第111期节目中也采访过Gavin Clark。

sentences.en: And we have him coming up again in 119.
sentences.zh: 在第119期节目中我们还会再次邀请他。

sentences.en: And he is a wheelchair user.
sentences.zh: 他也是一位轮椅使用者。

sentences.en: And so hopefully at least what we're doing with this podcast is we are opening your eyes and your vista for what psychologists look like.
sentences.zh: 因此，希望我们通过这个播客所做的，至少是开阔你们的眼界和视野，让你们看到心理学家究竟是什么样子的。

sentences.en: You know, they don't all walk on two legs.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们并非全都是用两条腿走路。

sentences.en: Some of them wheeling in badass wheelchairs.
sentences.zh: 其中有些人坐在帅气的轮椅上。,

sentences.en: You know, that is what modern psychologists look like.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这就是现代心理学家的模样。

sentences.en: And of course, they might well have more difficult journeys, different kind of different landscape to navigate in order to get to be working in psychology.
sentences.zh: 当然，为了能够从事心理学工作，他们很可能会经历更艰难的历程，需要适应不同类型的环境和挑战。

sentences.en: So Yvonne spoke about kind of in the past that meetings had been on the wrong floor and there was no access for her, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以Yvonne曾谈到，过去有些会议安排在错误的楼层，对她来说根本无法通行，你知道的。

sentences.en: But I hope in modern UK, certainly, that this is changing and that when these things are observed, because of course,
sentences.zh: 但我希望在现代的英国，情况肯定在改变，当这些问题被注意到时——当然，

sentences.en: if there's never been anyone who's a wheelchair user in the team before, the building is just not equipped for it, that necessarily these questions haven't cropped up.
sentences.zh: 如果团队中以前从未有过轮椅使用者，大楼就只是没有为此配备无障碍设施，这些问题以前自然也就没有出现过。

sentences.en: But once they are noticed and observed, I hope that that action can be taken so that everybody can comfortably use and deliver services, regardless of whether they walk,
sentences.zh: 但一旦被发现和注意到，我希望能够采取行动，让每个人都能舒适地使用和提供服务，无论他们是靠双腿行走，

sentences.en: whether they use a stick, whether they use a frame or whether they use wheels.
sentences.zh: 还是使用拐杖、助行架，抑或是靠轮椅出行。

sentences.en: So that is our reason for reason five is linked to pay and esteem and respect.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们的第五个原因，它与薪酬、社会地位和尊重息息相关。

sentences.en: You know, maybe someone has told you you're not a proper doctor, you know, you're not really that important.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，也许有人对你说过“你算不上真正的医生”，你知道的，“你其实没那么重要”。

sentences.en: Or is it really worth accruing all of that student debt just to sit around and hear people's problems?
sentences.zh: 或者说：“为了坐在这里听别人诉说烦恼，背上所有的学生债务真的值得吗？”

sentences.en: You know, I don't think you ought to do that.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我不认为你应该去做那种事。

sentences.en: Perhaps you ought to focus on being a medical doctor.
sentences.zh: 也许你应该专注于成为一名医学医生。

sentences.en: Perhaps you ought to focus on something where you're going to be more lucrative, like law or accountancy, you know.
sentences.zh: 也许你应该专注于一些能赚更多钱的行业，比如法律或会计，你知道的。

sentences.en: But you get to do what you want to do and what feels like it lights you up and excites you.
sentences.zh: 但你可以做你想做的事，做那些让你感到热血沸腾、充满激情的事。

sentences.en: And that's kind of regardless of what your family, what your friends, maybe what other people in your circle or even in your teams might think.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上与你的家人、你的朋友、或许还有你圈子里甚至团队里其他人的想法无关。

sentences.en: You get to do, you get to strive for doing what you want to do.
sentences.zh: 你可以去做，你可以努力去做你想做的事。

sentences.en: And sometimes, you know, having difficult conversations can be useful in terms of advocating for ourselves.
sentences.zh: 有时候，你知道的，进行艰难的对话在为自己争取权益方面是很有用的。

sentences.en: And I know if you come from a family that's kind of very set in what its expectations of you are, that can be challenging.
sentences.zh: 我知道，如果你来自一个对你抱有既定期望的家庭，那可能会很有挑战性。

sentences.en: But it doesn't make you wrong for wanting to do what you want to do.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着你想做自己想做的事就是错的。

sentences.en: And ultimately, it is your life.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这是你的人生。

sentences.en: We're not living our lives for our parents, for our grandparents.
sentences.zh: 我们不是为了父母、为了祖父母而活着。

sentences.en: You know, we are also growing up in different times than they were.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们生长的时代也和他们不同。

sentences.en: And we're allowed to make different choices.
sentences.zh: 我们有权做出不同的选择。

sentences.en: And maybe, I don't know, maybe this is a sexism thing as well.
sentences.zh: 也许，我不知道，也许这也是一种性别歧视的问题。

sentences.en: Maybe they think women shouldn't be working.
sentences.zh: 也许他们认为女性不应该工作。

sentences.en: That is still around in some cultures, in some families.
sentences.zh: 这种观念在某些文化、某些家庭中依然存在。

sentences.en: That's still some people's experience.
sentences.zh: 这仍然是某些人的亲身经历。

sentences.en: And that is not true either.
sentences.zh: 这也是不对的。

sentences.en: Regardless of your gender, you can be a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 无论你的性别如何，你都可以成为一名心理学家。

sentences.en: And so I hope that is useful if that's a message you needed to hear.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果这是你需要听到的声音，我希望这对你有所帮助。

sentences.en: Reason number six is about career progression.
sentences.zh: 第六个原因关于职业发展。

sentences.en: You're not going to move up the ladder.
sentences.zh: 你将无法在职级上有所晋升。

sentences.en: There's not enough.
sentences.zh: 上升空间不够。

sentences.en: You know, you'll be band seven.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你永远只是个七级职员。

sentences.en: You'll be band eight.
sentences.zh: 你永远只是个八级职员。

sentences.en: You know, you'll struggle to get much beyond that.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你想超越这个级别会很艰难。

sentences.en: It's a bit boring.
sentences.zh: 这有点无聊。

sentences.en: It's not diverse enough.
sentences.zh: 不够多元化。

sentences.en: You know, what can you possibly do?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你到底能做些什么？

sentences.en: You're just sitting in a chair all day.
sentences.zh: 你只是整天坐在椅子上。

sentences.en: How's that going to be enough for you?
sentences.zh: 这怎么能满足你呢？

sentences.en: To which I would say, that's just not true.
sentences.zh: 对此我想说，这根本不是真的。

sentences.en: You know, I look at psychologists.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，看看我们这些心理学家。

sentences.en: You know, even my own career, I see clients for therapy.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就拿我自己的职业生涯来说，我接待来访者做治疗。

sentences.en: I do this brilliant podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我做这个棒极了的播客。

sentences.en: Watching on YouTube, like and subscribe.
sentences.zh: 在YouTube上观看，请点赞并订阅。

sentences.en: Share this episode.
sentences.zh: 分享这期节目。

sentences.en: Tell your friends.
sentences.zh: 告诉你的朋友们。

sentences.en: If you're listening on Apple or Spotify, please do rate and review.
sentences.zh: 如果你在Apple或Spotify上收听，请务必给出评分和评论。

sentences.en: That would be so gratefully received.
sentences.zh: 对此我将不胜感激。

sentences.en: I'm an author.
sentences.zh: 我是一名作家。

sentences.en: I've got four books.
sentences.zh: 我已经出了四本书。

sentences.en: Doing media stuff.
sentences.zh: 做媒体相关的工作。

sentences.en: TV, radio, print journalism, online journalism.
sentences.zh: 电视、广播、纸媒、网络新闻。

sentences.en: Like my career is so diverse and so broad.
sentences.zh: 我的职业生涯就是这么多元且广阔。

sentences.en: And I see, you know, educational psychologists doing similar things.
sentences.zh: 而且我看到，你知道的，教育心理学家们也在做类似的事情。

sentences.en: I see counselling psychologists.
sentences.zh: 我看到了咨询心理学家。

sentences.en: So my friend and colleague, Dr. Tara Quincherillo, who we recently co-authored the book Talking Heads,
sentences.zh: 比如我的朋友兼同事Tara Quincherillo博士，我们最近合著了《会说话的头脑》一书，

sentences.en: Your Guide to Finding a Qualified Therapist in the UK, was published.
sentences.zh: 副标题是《在英国寻找合格治疗师指南》，这本书已经出版了。

sentences.en: And she's doing brilliant things as well.
sentences.zh: 她也在做非常棒的事情。

sentences.en: You know, you are not limited.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你不会受到局限。

sentences.en: It is not a little box that you will find yourself in.
sentences.zh: 你并不会被限制在一个狭小的框架里。

sentences.en: Even in the teams, if you end up employed, there is still diversity in that career.
sentences.zh: 即便是在团队里，如果你最终选择受雇于人，那个职业本身依然具有多样性。

sentences.en: You can still look to carve out niches for yourself.
sentences.zh: 你依然可以为自己开辟出一片专长领域。

sentences.en: And you can also move jobs as well.
sentences.zh: 你也可以跳槽。

sentences.en: So I went from being a CAMHS clinician for four years to then moving to become, primarily because I wanted to work closer to home and it was a pay rise,
sentences.zh: 所以，我从担任CAMHS（儿童及青少年心理健康服务）临床医生四年，到后来转行——主要是因为我想在离家更近的地方工作并且能加薪——

sentences.en: to then working in an adult mental health service.
sentences.zh: 转去成人心理健康服务部门工作。

sentences.en: And it was a very big change, a very big jump.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常大的改变，跨度很大。

sentences.en: But I guess I was looking at the needs of myself and my family at that time.
sentences.zh: 但我当时考虑的是自己和家人的需求。

sentences.en: And it's been transformational for me.
sentences.zh: 这对我的生活带来了颠覆性的转变。

sentences.en: So had I not had a family, I might well have continued in CAMHS.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我没有组建家庭，我很可能会继续留在CAMHS。

sentences.en: And who knows where I would be?
sentences.zh: 谁知道我现在会在哪里呢？

sentences.en: I loved my role in CAMHS, but I also love where I've ended up.
sentences.zh: 我很热爱我在CAMHS的角色，但我也同样热爱我最终的归宿。

sentences.en: So it is a broad career.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个广阔的职业领域。

sentences.en: It is a long time that we will be working in it.
sentences.zh: 我们将在这个行业里工作很长很长的时间。

sentences.en: That said, please do check out episode 109 of the podcast, which was myself and Ian Dempsey, an independent financial advisor where we were looking at pensions.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，请务必收听播客第109期，那期节目是我和独立理财顾问Ian Dempsey一起探讨养老金的节目。

sentences.en: Let's make sure that you are going to have enough money when you get to retirement.
sentences.zh: 我们要确保等你到了退休年龄时，能有足够的资金。

sentences.en: It's a great episode and it's doing really good things on YouTube specifically.
sentences.zh: 那是一期很棒的节目，特别是在YouTube上反响非常好。

sentences.en: So go and check that out.
sentences.zh: 所以快去看看吧。

sentences.en: There is absolutely not limited growth.
sentences.zh: 发展空间绝对没有受限。

sentences.en: I know of people working in Band 9.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，有人做到了九级岗位。

sentences.en: I know of qualified clinical psychologists who have gone on to work at directorate level in NHS trusts.
sentences.zh: 我也认识一些合格的临床心理学家，他们后来在NHS信托基金会晋升到了董事会级别。

sentences.en: It's infinitely possible.
sentences.zh: 一切皆有可能。

sentences.en: There is growth.
sentences.zh: 这里有成长空间。

sentences.en: If you have the drive, I would say psychology has got the opportunities for you.
sentences.zh: 如果你有进取心，我想说心理学行业为你提供了无限机遇。

sentences.en: Last but not least, reason number seven is a thankless job.
sentences.zh: 最后但同样重要的是，第七个原因——这是一份吃力不讨好的工作。

sentences.en: You're never going to make a difference.
sentences.zh: 你永远无法改变什么。

sentences.en: Mental health is too big for little old you to make a big enough ripple.
sentences.zh: 心理健康问题如此庞大，凭你这个微不足道的小人物根本掀不起什么大风浪。

sentences.en: That I would say it doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 对此我想说，这根本没关系。

sentences.en: Even if you make small ripples, even if you just do one-to-one work with clients and that makes a difference.
sentences.zh: 哪怕你只能激起微小的涟漪，哪怕你只是和来访者进行一对一的工作并带来了改变，

sentences.en: That's enough.
sentences.zh: 那就足够了。

sentences.en: How many times in our lives do we get bored of hearing, if I hadn't done this work with you, I would have ended my own life?
sentences.zh: 在我们的一生中，听到过多少次这样的话：“如果不是和你做了这些工作，我已经结束自己的生命了”？

sentences.en: That is incredibly powerful and that matters.
sentences.zh: 那具有难以置信的力量，而且意义重大。

sentences.en: Recall some stats on cost of suicide to the economy because, of course, when life ends, that means they're no longer earning.
sentences.zh: 回想一下关于自杀对经济造成成本的一些统计数据，因为当然，当生命终结时，意味着他们不再有收入。

sentences.en: They're no longer working.
sentences.zh: 他们不再工作。

sentences.en: They're no longer paying tax.
sentences.zh: 他们不再纳税。

sentences.en: They're no longer buying things from the corner shop.
sentences.zh: 他们不再去街角小店买东西。

sentences.en: They're no longer going to supermarkets.
sentences.zh: 他们不再去超市。

sentences.en: They're no longer going to gyMs.
sentences.zh: 他们不再去健身房。

sentences.en: You know, there's a massive financial impact and a loss to society for each and every person who ends their life by suicide.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，对于每一个选择自杀结束生命的人来说，都会给社会带来巨大的财务影响和损失。

sentences.en: And that's not supposed to sound like a criticism.
sentences.zh: 这并不是听起来像在批评谁。

sentences.en: It's not.
sentences.zh: 并不是这样的。

sentences.en: It's that this isn't just a loss to families and loved ones who care about this person.
sentences.zh: 而是说这不仅是那些关心这个人的家庭和挚爱之人的损失。

sentences.en: This is a societal loss, you know.
sentences.zh: 这也是整个社会的损失，你知道的。

sentences.en: It's a loss of hope.
sentences.zh: 这是希望的损失。

sentences.en: It's a loss of that person's life being different.
sentences.zh: 是这个人本可以拥有不同人生的损失。

sentences.en: It's a loss of them being able to do something really incredible for their community, for the world, in their living years.
sentences.zh: 是他们在有生之年无法为自己的社区、为世界做出真正不可思议的贡献的损失。

sentences.en: So, obviously, sometimes things go on after people have ended their own lives that go around them as part of people setting up trusts or charities.
sentences.zh: 所以，很显然，有时在人们结束自己的生命之后，人们会围绕他们成立信托基金或慈善机构，以此延续一些事情。

sentences.en: But how wonderful it would be if that person had been better supported to go on to do these incredible things whilst they were living.
sentences.zh: 但如果那个人在世时能得到更好的支持，去继续创造这些不可思议的成就，那该有多好啊。

sentences.en: We do great things.
sentences.zh: 我们做得很棒。

sentences.en: Psychologists are great.
sentences.zh: 心理学家们都很棒。

sentences.en: Whichever profession, whichever discipline it is that you want to go into, it's just brilliant.
sentences.zh: 无论你想从事哪个职业、哪门学科，都是极其精彩的。

sentences.en: I've said it before, I will say it again, I have the best job in the world.
sentences.zh: 我以前说过，我还要再说一遍，我拥有世界上最好的工作。

sentences.en: I get to do so many brilliant things and it's honestly a privilege.
sentences.zh: 我能做那么多精彩的事情，这真的是一种荣幸。

sentences.en: It's a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: You can go as big as you want to go.
sentences.zh: 你可以把目标定得尽可能宏大。

sentences.en: You can do what I do.
sentences.zh: 你可以做我做的事。

sentences.en: You can write books.
sentences.zh: 你可以写书。

sentences.en: You can, you know, do media to impact on as many people as you like.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你也可以通过媒体去影响尽可能多的人。

sentences.en: Or you can keep it as little as you like.
sentences.zh: 或者你也可以把规模保持得尽可能小。

sentences.en: But it all matters.
sentences.zh: 但这一切都很重要。

sentences.en: And thank you for doing what you do.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你所做的一切。

sentences.en: So, we've taken a whistle stop tour through seven reasons that you might have been told or that you might believe means that you cannot have a career in psychology.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们快速浏览了七个理由，这些理由可能是别人告诉你的，或者你可能认为它们意味着你无法从事心理学职业。

sentences.en: I'm really hoping we have debunked those myths.
sentences.zh: 我真心希望我们已经彻底打破了这些迷思。

sentences.en: And if you would like to connect with me, please do come and do so.
sentences.zh: 如果你想与我联系，请务必前来。

sentences.en: There will be a QR code on screen if you're watching on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 如果你在YouTube上观看，屏幕上会有一个二维码。

sentences.en: But basically, I am Dr. Marianne Trent everywhere.
sentences.zh: 但基本上，我在各处的昵称都是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: Please do check out the videos on screen that are being suggested to you if you're watching on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 如果你在YouTube上观看，请务必查看屏幕上推荐给你的视频。

sentences.en: Please do consider coming along to the Aspiring Psychology community, which is my free Facebook group.
sentences.zh: 请考虑加入“有志心理学家”社区，这是我的免费Facebook群组。

sentences.en: And if you need a little bit more support or guidance, please do consider the Aspiring Psychologist membership.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要更多一点的支持或指导，请考虑加入“有志心理学家”会员计划。

sentences.en: People are getting great results and finding that they even get assistant psychologist roles because they are feeling so much more competent and confident in their abilities.
sentences.zh: 大家取得了很好的成果，发现自己甚至得到了心理学助理的职位，因为他们对自己的能力感到更加胜任和自信。

sentences.en: I will look forward to coming to you with our next episode of the Aspiring Psychologist podcast, which will be around from 6 a.m.
sentences.zh: 我期待着为您带来我们的下一期《有志心理学家》播客节目，该节目将于周一上午6点左右上线。

sentences.en: on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And take care.
sentences.zh: 请多保重。

sentences.en: What if your professional expertise could earn you money even when you're not working?
sentences.zh: 如果你的专业知识甚至在你没工作的时候也能为你赚钱，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: And since 2019, I've been building additional income streams through books, online courses and memberships.
sentences.zh: 自2019年以来，我一直通过书籍、在线课程和会员计划建立额外的收入来源。

sentences.en: And it's made such a difference to my business and my life.
sentences.zh: 这给我的业务和生活带来了巨大的改变。

sentences.en: Tonight at 7 p.m., Sophie Foote is hosting a free Make Money Online Masterclass, exploring how you could turn your existing skills and knowledge into additional income streaMs.
sentences.zh: 今晚7点，苏菲·富特将主持一场免费的“线上赚钱大师班”，探讨如何将你现有的技能和知识转化为额外的收入来源。

sentences.en: And I'd love more psychologists and mental health professionals to join us.
sentences.zh: 我非常希望更多的心理学家和心理健康专业人士能加入我们。

sentences.en: I'll be there, too, supporting a lovely community of fellow psychologists, exploring what's possible beyond one-to-one work.
sentences.zh: 我也将在那里，支持一个由同行心理学家组成的可爱社区，探索一对一工作之外的无限可能。

sentences.en: Replays are available if you can't join live.
sentences.zh: 如果你无法参加直播，提供回放。

sentences.en: Click the link with this pre-roll or reach out to me on socials to grab your free place.
sentences.zh: 点击此片头广告中的链接，或在社交媒体上联系我以获取你的免费名额。

sentences.en: Because you can serve others and deserve financial freedom, too.
sentences.zh: 因为你既可以服务他人，也同样理应获得财务自由。
